insertion_intent: Future adapter: correct final cumulative Local anchor proposal immediately before original Base+Global+Local sum, using original fixed RBF W. Never add cumulative corrections as extra frame velocities.
contract: Original Local GS mean retained. Only candidate correction is centered using W-induced anchor masses; its interpolated RMS is bounded relative to original demeaned Local RMS. Units are unchanged; masks mandatory. Zero candidate is identity.
not_implemented: admitted material graph for real data
graph_policy: No automatic spatial16NN material edges. Cross-layer admissibility remains unresolved. No future GT or inferred GT point correspondence allowed.
hyperparameter_policy: Required API argument; synthetic tests use 0.25 solely to check algebra, not a selected training value. No held-out tuning.
limitations: GS-weighted mean preservation is not physical momentum conservation
pure-translation Local has zero relative correction budget
not a bending or SO3 rigidity constraint
zero correction with positive relative motion must allow learning gradients
G5 frozen baseline lives outside this main-based prototype; no production integration
Length-only head cannot distinguish reflection, inversion or interpenetration. It permits bending only to the extent admitted edge lengths permit it.
Signed learned gains are not guaranteed restoring forces; RMS cap is not a convergence proof.
GS-mean centering can induce a uniform countershift even at isolated anchors. No pinned-gripper constraint is implemented.
next_gate: Review graph admissibility and candidate-head design before integrating or authorizing any GPU run. Preserve original G5 source and all checkpoint semantics.

candidate_head.inputs: initial reference anchors and total original Base+Global+Local proposal coordinates; fixed externally admitted undirected edges; validity masks
candidate_head.formula: strain=(length(proposed_edge)-length(reference_edge))/length(reference_edge); gain=tanh(MLP(strain)); pair_message=gain*(length(proposed_edge)-length(reference_edge))*unit(proposed_edge); antisymmetric scatter / graph maximum degree; then GS-weighted transport guard
candidate_head.initialization: last linear layer zero; identical Local at initialization; last layer can learn on nonrigid examples with positive downstream correction budget
candidate_head.hyperparameters: hidden_dim and min_length are required, not selected for training. Synthetic tests use hidden_dim=8 and min_length=1e-8 in synthetic coordinate units. max_ratio remains unset.
candidate_head.gradient: reference/proposed geometry retain gradients; no SVD
candidate_head.scope: experimental edge-length response, not a physical force or a complete ARAP solver

graph_admission_contract.source: Initial-frame information only. Spatial proximity alone is insufficient. No GT matching, future frames or predicted-neighbor rebuilding.
graph_admission_contract.admitted_mask: Caller must record why each edge is admissible. A boolean is not evidence of material connectivity. No real-data edges approved in this step.
hard_rejections: initial or proposed admitted edge at/below min_length
graph_admission_contract.empty_graph: returns zero; caller must report edge/anchor coverage and cannot call this successful shape correction
future_records: admission evidence and fixed graph reuse across horizon
